description.narrative: Overall objective: To enhance urban governance of Inhambane Province (Mozambique) through the design and implementation of Sustainable, Inclusive and Resilient spatial planning SO1: To strengthen the institutional and strategic capacities of the local and regional public authorities to design and implement inclusive, sustainable and resilient urban plans in a responsive and accountable manner. SO2: To foster equitable access of all citizens, especially of groups in vulnerable situation to safe municipal infrastructures and basic quality services SO3: To create new inclusive business and job opportunities through the implementation of the urban plans
